scoring_justification: Checker recomputes per-system averages of Fe–O bond enthalpy and sulfur spin density from the agent's raw CSV, then compares to paper-reported values with tolerances and checks the required relative trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold average ΔE₂ and sulfur spin density for P450cam_apo and P450cam_prop, derived from paper Table 2 (spin densities) and Table 3 (ΔE₂).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables 2 and 3 (P450cam rows). Table 3: apo ΔE₂ = 54.9 kcal mol⁻¹, prop ΔE₂ = 52.1 kcal mol⁻¹. Table 2: apo ρ(S) = 0.34, prop ρ(S) = 0.27.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the published paper; verified against the reference solution's synthetic CSV that reproduces these averages exactly.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for this isoform, not arbitrary.

outputs.description: Per-snapshot properties and Fe–O bond enthalpy for both P450cam_apo and P450cam_prop systems, enabling the checker to compute ensemble averages and verify the substrate effect.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run the full MD → MM minimization → QM/MM optimization pipeline; the scored CSV is only produced after all prior stages. At least 5 snapshots per system are required. The checker will compute per-system averages from this CSV and compare them to hidden reference values.
